# Cross-implementation corpus for the native/ build-input rule (scope build-inputs-v2).
# Each line is pinned or unpinned, one space, then a path relative to the repository root. The rule looks at the file name only: a name is pinned when it is listed or ends with a listed suffix, matched exactly and case-sensitively.
# tests/test_native_build_inputs.py and rust/crates/tokspur-cli/tests/cli_lifecycle.rs build a tree from these paths and require the same inventory from the Python and the Rust collector. Paths that differ only in case sit in different directories so the tree also builds on case-insensitive filesystems.
